subject: Klopp says FIFA is worse than in Blatter's day and hopes Infantino is replaced
title: Klopp: FIFA worse than Blatter

lines.vo: Klopp just said FIFA is worse than in Blatter's day. Ouch.
Germany coach Jürgen Klopp hopes Gianni Infantino gets replaced. Klopp was never known for whispering.
Critics point to FIFA's handling of Folarin Balogun's red card at the World Cup. It still let him play against Belgium. A red card, apparently, is more of a suggestion.
Backlash also hit a proposed twenty billion dollar World Cup company with private investors. Twenty billion dollars. Somewhere, a calculator is crying.
Blatter was banned from football in twenty-fifteen. Klopp says it has got worse since. Bold review.
The election is in Rabat on the eighteenth of March, twenty twenty-seven. Bring popcorn. Klopp brings the opinions.

inserts.story: Setup: a cutout Klopp in cap and glasses shouts into a tiny microphone. Gag: a generic cutout official behind him holds up three signs in a row: NOT ME, STILL NOT ME, ASK ME LATER. Twist: the microphone squeals and the official slides under the table.
inserts.characters: South Park style cutout Klopp (cap and glasses caricature); generic cutout official

inserts.story: Setup: a cutout Klopp hangs a dusty frame labelled OLD DAYS on a wall. Gag: he steps back, squints and sticks a note under it that says THEN. Twist: he pulls out a bigger frame labelled NOW and the wall collapses under its weight.
inserts.characters: cutout Klopp; cutout picture frames; no real officials shown

inserts.story: Setup: a cutout Klopp taps a giant calculator showing 20,000,000,000. Gag: the zeros spill off the screen and roll across the floor. Twist: a generic cutout referee shows the calculator a red card and it walks off.
inserts.characters: cutout Klopp; cutout calculator; generic cutout referee

facts_used: Germany coach Klopp said he hopes Infantino is replaced and that FIFA is worse since Blatter (ev0135)
Infantino criticised over handling of USA striker Folarin Balogun's red card at the World Cup (ev0135)
Infantino faced backlash for a proposed 20 billion dollar World Cup company with private investors (ev0135)
Blatter was banned from football in 2015 over a payment to Michel Platini (ev0135 background)
notes: Comic, 3 inserts (after_line counts from 1). Political-sporting topic: jokes aim at FIFA's documented handling and at Klopp's known outspokenness, no personal insults to Infantino or Blatter. Blatter's ban is stated neutrally with no joke on it (legal-trouble rule); the reason (a payment to Platini) is deliberately left out. Fixed earlier wording: source says FIFA is worse 'since Blatter', not that the current boss is worse than Blatter. Generic cutouts for officials. 'Never known for whispering' is a light caricature, not a fact claim.
